P1.TITLE: How do I create an account?
P1.ANSWER: To create an account, go to the registration section, enter your email address, create a secure password and complete your profile as a client or tattoo artist.

P2.TITLE: How do I book an appointment with a tattoo artist?
P2.ANSWER: You can book an appointment from the tattoo artist's profile. Select the date, time and the service you want. Then confirm the appointment and you will receive a notification.

P3.TITLE: Can I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
P3.ANSWER: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule your appointment from the 'My appointments' section. We recommend doing so at least 24 hours in advance to avoid charges.

P4.TITLE: How do reviews and ratings work?
P4.ANSWER: After your appointment, you can leave a review and rate the tattoo artist based on your experience. This helps other users make informed decisions.

P5.TITLE: How do I find tattoo artists near me?
P5.ANSWER: Use the search bar and enable location to see nearby tattoo artists. You can filter by style, price, ratings and availability.

P6.TITLE: Can I communicate with the tattoo artist before the appointment?
P6.ANSWER: Yes, you can send messages to the tattoo artist from their profile or from your appointment details once it is confirmed.

P7.TITLE: How do I report a problem with a tattoo artist or an appointment?
P7.ANSWER: If you had a bad experience or there was a problem, you can report it from the tattoo artist's profile.

P8.TITLE: What do I do if a tattoo artist does not show up for the appointment?
P8.ANSWER: We are sorry for the situation. Please report it from the support section so we can help you resolve the case and apply the appropriate policies.

P9.TITLE: Can I save my favourite tattoo artists?
P9.ANSWER: Yes, you can mark tattoo artist profiles that interest you as favourites to easily access them later.

P10.TITLE: How can I register as a tattoo artist?
P10.ANSWER: From the registration screen, through our other application. Complete your professional profile, add photos of your work, services, prices and availability.

P11.TITLE: What security measures do you have to protect my data?
P11.ANSWER: Your information is protected through encryption and security protocols. We do not share your personal data without your consent.

P12.TITLE: How can I edit my profile?
P12.ANSWER: You can modify your personal information and more from the 'Profile' section in the application.

P13.TITLE: Can I receive reminders for my appointments?
P13.ANSWER: Yes, we will send you push notification reminders before your appointment so you don't forget it.

P14.TITLE: What tattoo styles can I find?
P14.ANSWER: You can search for tattoo artists by styles such as realism, traditional, minimalist, blackwork, and others, using the search filters.

P15.TITLE: Can I upload references or ideas for my tattoo?
P15.ANSWER: Yes, you can upload reference images when booking your appointment or send them directly to the tattoo artist via chat.

P16.TITLE: How can I delete my account?
P16.ANSWER: You can delete your account from the settings section. Please note that this action is irreversible and all your data will be lost.

P17.TITLE: Can I book multiple appointments at the same time?
P17.ANSWER: Yes, you can book multiple appointments with the same tattoo artist or with different artists, depending on your availability and needs.

P18.TITLE: What do I do if I forgot my password?
P18.ANSWER: On the Account screen within your profile or when logging in, click 'Forgot your password?' and follow the instructions to reset it.

P19.TITLE: How do I contact support if I have a problem?
P19.ANSWER: You can contact support from the 'Help Centre' section or by sending an email to almeyda.dw.studio@gmail.com.

P20.TITLE: Can I change my personal information?
P20.ANSWER: Yes, you can update your personal information, including name, phone number and profile photo, from the 'Profile' section.

PRIVACY_INTRO: Welcome to the Privacy Policy of iTattoo. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, who we share it with and what your rights are as a user. Compliance is governed by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, EU 2016/679) and applicable Spanish legislation.
PRIVACY_SECTION_1_TEXT: Dario Almeida, self-employed professional registered in Spain. To exercise your rights or for legal enquiries: almeyda.dw.studio@gmail.com.
PRIVACY_SECTION_2_TEXT: When you register and use the app, we collect the following data:
PRIVACY_SECTION_2_POINT_6: Information related to your appointments: tattoo zone, allergies, relevant medical conditions, sketches and reference images
PRIVACY_SECTION_2_POINT_7: Technical device data: model, operating system, push notification token
PRIVACY_SECTION_3_TEXT: The allergies and medical conditions you provide when booking an appointment are special category data under Article 9 of the GDPR. This data is processed solely with your explicit consent, for the purpose of ensuring your safety during the tattooing process, and is only accessible by the professional with whom you have booked.
PRIVACY_SECTION_4_TEXT: We process your data under the following legal bases: (a) Performance of a contract: to provide you with the app's services. (b) Consent: for push notifications and health data — you may withdraw this at any time. (c) Legal obligation: to comply with tax or legal requirements. (d) Legitimate interest: to improve the app and prevent fraud.
PRIVACY_SECTION_5_TEXT: If you grant location permissions, iTattoo will use your coordinates to show you nearby tattoo artists. We do not share your location with third parties. You can revoke this permission at any time from your device settings.
PRIVACY_SECTION_6_POINT_1: Provide you with tattoo artist search and booking services.
PRIVACY_SECTION_6_POINT_2: Manage your appointments and send you related notifications.
PRIVACY_SECTION_6_POINT_3: Show you relevant tattoo artists based on your location and preferences.
PRIVACY_SECTION_6_POINT_4: Resolve disputes and improve platform security.
PRIVACY_SECTION_7_TEXT: We do not sell or transfer your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. We may share it with: (a) The tattoo artist with whom you book an appointment, exclusively the data necessary for that appointment. (b) Infrastructure providers (Firebase/Google Cloud) for storage and authentication, under GDPR-compliant agreements. (c) Payment platforms (App Store, Google Play) to manage subscriptions — we do not store bank card data. (d) Competent authorities, when required by law.
PRIVACY_SECTION_8_TEXT: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures: encryption in transit (HTTPS), secure authentication and restricted data access. In the event of a security breach affecting your rights, we will notify you in accordance with the GDPR. We recommend using a strong password and not sharing your credentials.
PRIVACY_SECTION_9_TEXT: Under the GDPR, you have the right to: access your data, rectify it, request its deletion, obtain its portability, restrict its processing or object to it. To exercise any of these rights, send an email to almeyda.dw.studio@gmail.com. We will respond within a maximum of 30 days. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
PRIVACY_SECTION_10_TEXT: We retain your data while you have an active account and, after its deletion, for the time necessary to comply with legal obligations. You can request the deletion of your account and data at any time by sending an email to almeyda.dw.studio@gmail.com.
PRIVACY_SECTION_11_TEXT_1: Some of our providers (such as Google/Firebase) may process data on servers outside the European Economic Area.
PRIVACY_SECTION_11_TEXT_2: In such cases, we ensure that appropriate safeguards exist in accordance with the GDPR: standard contractual clauses or other mechanisms recognised by the European Commission.
PRIVACY_SECTION_12_TEXT: iTattoo is intended exclusively for users aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we detect that a user is a minor, we will proceed to delete their account and data.
PRIVACY_SECTION_13_TEXT: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of relevant changes through the app or by email. The most recent version will always be available in the app.
